hooks.name: Security Check on Save
hooks.description: Scan src/ TypeScript files for unsafe patterns like eval, new Function, innerHTML, and fetch

action.command: node -e "const stdin = require('fs').readFileSync(0, 'utf-8'); const evt = JSON.parse(stdin); const fs = require('fs'); const content = fs.readFileSync(evt.filePath, 'utf-8'); const patterns = [/eval\(/g, /new Function/g, /\.innerHTML\s*=/g, /fetch\(/g]; const matches = []; patterns.forEach(p => { let m; while((m = p.exec(content)) !== null) matches.push(m[0]); }); if (matches.length > 0) { console.error('❌ Security violation: Found unsafe patterns in ' + evt.filePath + ': ' + matches.join(', ')); process.exit(2); } console.log('✓ Security check passed for ' + evt.filePath);"
